title: P-11 Contact (EN) — Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum

settings.editor: A point of contact for connecting with Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum.

This page brings together the ways to get in touch with the association in Rabat.

It is intended for individuals, associations and institutions wishing to request information or explore an exchange.

settings._title: S1 · IMAGE À REMPLACER — visuel institutionnel

settings.editor:
Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum is a Moroccan association based in Rabat. This page explains how to contact the association and the reasons for getting in touch.

Any request for information or proposal for an exchange may be addressed to the association.

settings._title: S4 · Motif 1 — Informations générales sur l'associati

settings.editor: Request information about the association's identity, statutory orientations or organizational structure.

settings._title: S4 · Motif 2 — Échanges institutionnels et partenaria

settings.editor: Propose an exchange between organizations. The association's statutes provide for collaboration with associations sharing the same objectives, at both national and international levels.
